info.title: veo/veo-3.1-generate-001
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "veo/veo-3.1-generate-001", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

aspectRatio.description: Aspect ratio of the generated video. Default: 16:9

durationSeconds.description: Target duration of the generated video in seconds. Veo 2: 5-8. Veo 3/3.1: 4, 6, or 8. Default: 8

enhancePrompt.description: Automatically improve prompt for higher quality. Defaults to true.

fps.description: Frame rate of generated videos in frames per second

generateAudio.description: Whether to generate audio along with the video. Defaults to true. Supported by Veo 3.0+ models.

negativePrompt.description: Text describing what to avoid in the generated video

personGeneration.description: Controls people in generated videos. Default: allow_adult

pubsubTopic.description: Cloud Pub/Sub topic for progress updates (projects/{project}/topics/{topic}). Not accepted on Comfy-credentialed (non-BYOK) requests: the generate route answers 400 if it is present, because the operation runs in Comfy's project and Vertex would publish as Comfy's service agent. Accepted only on bring-your-own-key requests, where Vertex evaluates the topic grant in your own project.

resizeMode.description: Resize approach for input image. Default: pad

resolution.description: Output video resolution. Supported by Veo 3.0+ models. Default: 720p

sampleCount.description: Number of videos to generate. If not specified, 1 video is generated.

seed.description: Random seed for deterministic output. Different seeds used per video if sampleCount > 1.

storageUri.description:
Optional Cloud Storage destination for the generated videos, as a `gs://` URI.
IT MUST NAME A BUCKET OF YOUR OWN. Outside bring-your-own-key, this route runs under Comfy's own Google Cloud credentials rather than yours, so a destination inside a Comfy-owned bucket would be a write performed by Comfy's service account, into a shared layout, billed to Comfy's project. A request naming one is refused with a 400 and nothing is generated — with one exception on a synchronous Comfy Router call (`POST /v2/models/{provider}/{model}`) where platform storage is enabled: a value naming Router's own Veo or Gemini asset bucket is replaced with a destination Router mints under your own platform prefix for that call (see the Router Veo route), and only that exact Router-minted destination is let through. A queued Router submit (`POST /v2/models/{provider}/{model}/requests`) makes no such replacement, so it refuses that value with a 400 like any other Comfy-owned bucket. Any other destination is forwarded to Vertex unchanged and is yours to grant access to. A bring-your-own-key call runs in your own project and is forwarded as sent.
